rv.q: This Hay Fever will make you sneeze with pleasure.
Kendal is terrific, bringing a credibility to Judith, singing like an ageing chanteuse or sliding down a banister in an emotional slump.
Lindsay Posner's production transferring to the West End from Theatre Royal Bath for a limited run - does few favours to one of Coward's best known plays.
Posner is now more often a director of care than of flair, and what distinguishes his staging of Hay Fever is its refusal to go over the top even when positively required.
Lindsay Posner directs with pace and subtle panache and does the play and everyone watching and acting in it the favour of paring the evening down to a breezy two hours.
